hooks.command: g="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/guard/guard.sh"; if [ -f "$g" ]; then exec sh "$g"; fi; i=$(cat); for r in "${CODEX_BRIDGE_HOME:-$HOME/.codex-bridge}"/sessions/*/roster/*; do [ -f "$r" ] || continue; a=${r##*/}; if printf %s "$i" | grep -Eq "\"agent_id\" *: *\"$a\""; then echo 'codex-bridge: the Guard script is missing, so this Worker may not run tools' >&2; exit 2; fi; done; exit 0
